task: Predict SETD1B mutation status in colon adenocarcinoma. Classes: negative vs. positive. On H&E, useful cues are limited, but differences may relate to tumor differentiation, architectural disorder, mucinous change, and inflammatory or stromal context visible on routine sections.

classes.0: SETD1B-negative tumor without distinctive morphology beyond conventional colon adenocarcinoma patterns.
classes.1: SETD1B-positive tumor with relatively disordered architecture, variable differentiation, and possible mucinous or inflammatory features.
